mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_human_review (case_id, reviewer_user_id, public_id, condition_type, purpose, candidate_visible, protocol_text, instruction) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{publicId}, #{conditionType}, 'PRIMARY', 1, #{protocolText}, #{instruction})
mapper.update: UPDATE sim_human_review SET status = 'OPENED', opened_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE sim_human_review SET status = 'SUBMITTED', decision = #{decision}, reason = #{reason}, submitted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'OPENED')

UPDATE sim_assessment_case SET human_status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sim_human_review WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND purpose = 'PRIMARY' AND candidate_visible = 1 AND status = 'SUBMITTED') = 2 THEN 'COMPLETE' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_human_review WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND purpose = 'PRIMARY' AND status = 'SUBMITTED') THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_human_review WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND purpose = 'PRIMARY' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'OPENED')) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNED' END WHERE id = #{caseId}
